title: Lattice Hymn
premise: Nested brass lattices assemble around a single ember core and refuse to share a rotation. The hymn is the beat they miss together.
visual: Dark void, no floor. Four wireframe cubes and one icosahedron nested on a shared origin, brass line against a coal-orange core. The core is a matte sphere, not a star — it does not emit rays, only warmth. No HUD, no nebula, no faces.
motion: 0–4s: lattices scale in from nothing while the camera pushes. 4–12s: each shell counter-rotates; the camera completes one slow orbit. 12–16s: the core pulses once, camera eases back, shells keep their jobs. Loop on the opening scale.
